description: FDB never retries a resolver call: brokenPromiseToNever (CommitProxyServer.actor.cpp:1149) - the proxy waits; a dead resolver is detected externally and means recovery, because ApplyMetadataMutation's correctness demands every proxy see an identical stream. Bedrock's 3-attempt exponential ladder (finalization.ex:658-738) with duplicated {:error,_}/{:failure,_,_} clause pairs, two telemetry events and handlers, and attempts_used threading compensates for a failure mode the architecture already answers with recovery. Replace with a single call; failure -> {:error,{:resolver_unavailable,reason}} -> batch failed -> proxy exit -> director recovery. Also normalize the {:failure,reason,ref} shape (manufactured in resolver.ex:115-116) to {:error,reason}. ~70 lines + tracing handlers.
title: Trim: resolver calls fail fast instead of retrying
